column1: # The transport latency suite's matrix (transport.sh, estimate.py): data, not
# code. LAB_ARMS_FILE adds rows of the same two kinds. Fields are separated by
# whitespace; lists by commas; - is none.
# arm <name> <binary> <setup> <hosts> [<arguments>...]
#   binary   a bench binary on the VMs' PATH (transport-cli.md)
#   setup    none (no network), kernel or dpdk (a media driver: vm.sh driver),
#            dpdk-raw (the data NICs on DPDK and no driver: vm.sh driver
#            dpdk-raw; the raw floor's binary takes the driver's environment),
#            sockets (the kernel data path, busy poll: vm.sh sockets), fstack
#            (no media driver; the data NICs on igb_uio for the binary's own
#            DPDK: vm.sh fstack-up; AWS x86_64 only), onload (the binary, or
#            an Aeron arm's media driver, under OpenOnload over AF_XDP on the
#            data NICs: vm.sh onload-up; AWS only). A set with a dpdk, fstack
#            or onload arm has netem - (netem cannot reach a NIC DPDK holds,
#            nor Onload's AF_XDP sends)
#   hosts    one (both ends in one process on one host: rtt and one-way
#            rows), two (ping on host a, pong on host b: round trips) or
#            sink (one's runs on host a, each with a sink on host b reading
#            every frame its publications send: --mode spy-udp; a set on
#            host a, netem -, run alone)
#   arguments  the arm's own flags, after the runner's (transport-cli.md)
# smt <off|on>  (a sets file's, once) the session's SMT: off without it (vm.sh
#          transport-tune turns it off); on keeps it on, each isolated core
#          whole in the CPU map (host.sh transport_cpu_map), every arm a
#          two-host socket arm, T10 reported and the smt rule (fairness.py)
# set <id> <pair> <par> <host> <loads> <streams> <netem> <arms>
#   pair     the session (LAB_PAIR) that runs it: a or b
#   par      sets of one pair with the same tag run at once (one-host sets on
#            different hosts); - runs alone
#   host     a or b for one-host arms; ab for two-host arms
#   loads    msgs/s, every stream together (--rate); each a 30 s point, one run
#   streams  stream (or connection) counts; the first load 30 s of warm-up, later ones 5
#   netem    egress loss % on every data NIC of both hosts, one round each;
#            - no qdisc at all; 0 a netem qdisc dropping nothing; none a
#            round with no qdisc (checked on every data NIC), labelled
#            @NETEM=none, beside a set's netem levels
#   arms     arm names; aa is the A/A arm: the set's first arm again, its
#            rows labelled <set>:aa (fairness.py wants one in every round)
# Points: arms x loads x streams x netem levels x 5 reps.
# aeron-spy's publications have no destination: it sends nothing on the
# wire, so it measures IPC through a UDP publication's term buffer.
# aeron-spy-udp is the same round trip on publications that send every frame
# to a sink on host b (reliable, ssc=false: the sink connects them).
# aeron-ipc-huge is aeron-ipc with its Aeron directory on a 2 MiB hugetlbfs
# (TR_AERON_HUGE_DIR) in place of tmpfs: transport-settings.env's
# TR_DECLARED names that its one difference, and fairness.py checks nothing
# else differs.
arm  mpsc             mpsc_lat   none     one
arm  aeron-ipc        aeron_lat  kernel   one  --mode ipc
arm  aeron-ipc-huge   aeron_lat  kernel   one  --mode ipc
arm  aeron-spy        aeron_lat  kernel   one  --mode spy
arm  aeron-spy-udp    aeron_lat  kernel   sink --mode spy-udp
arm  dpdk-aeron-spy-udp aeron_lat dpdk    sink --mode spy-udp
arm  aeron-self       aeron_lat  kernel   one  --mode udp --reliable false
arm  dpdk-aeron-self  aeron_lat  dpdk     one  --mode udp --reliable false
arm  aeron-udp        aeron_lat  kernel   two  --mode udp --reliable false
arm  dpdk-aeron-udp   aeron_lat  dpdk     two  --mode udp --reliable false
arm  aeron-rel        aeron_lat  kernel   two  --mode udp --reliable true
arm  dpdk-aeron-rel   aeron_lat  dpdk     two  --mode udp --reliable true
# the hand-off arms: dpdk-aeron-rel's and aeron-rel's rows, each declared its
# twin but for its driver's place or threading (transport-settings.env
# TR_DECLARED; transport-aws-aeron-handoff.tsv)
arm  dpdk-aeron-rel-emb     aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true
arm  dpdk-aeron-rel-shnet   aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true
arm  dpdk-aeron-rel-shared  aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true
arm  dpdk-aeron-rel-invoker aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true
arm  aeron-rel-emb          aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true
arm  aeron-rel-invoker      aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true
# the mixed-load arms (transport-aws-aeron-mixed.tsv): a 64-byte hot stream at
# 10k msg/s measured beside background streams of steady, bursty and
# idle-then-burst traffic, 64 to 4096 B, fan-out 1 to 4 on the pong
# (aeron_lat --load mixed, mixed.rs); the set's load is every stream's. Each
# stack's in the five threading models, declared twins of its first
# (TR_DECLARED), as the hand-off arms
arm  aeron-mix              aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  aeron-mix-emb          aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  aeron-mix-shnet        aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  aeron-mix-shared       aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  aeron-mix-invoker      aeron_lat  kernel  two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  dpdk-aeron-mix         aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  dpdk-aeron-mix-emb     aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  dpdk-aeron-mix-shnet   aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  dpdk-aeron-mix-shared  aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
arm  dpdk-aeron-mix-invoker aeron_lat  dpdk    two  --mode udp --reliable true --load mixed --hot-rate 10000
# the raw DPDK floor: floor --role ping/pong over ergon-md-dpdk's packet path
# alone (no Aeron), one thread an end, on dpdk-raw's set-up (vm.sh driver
# dpdk-raw: the NICs on DPDK, no driver); mio-udp is the kernel's
arm  dpdk-raw         floor      dpdk-raw two
arm  mio-udp          udp_lat    sockets  two  --impl mio
arm  eio-udp          udp_lat    sockets  two  --impl ergon
arm  mio-tcp          tcp_lat    sockets  two  --impl mio
arm  eio-tcp          tcp_lat    sockets  two  --impl ergon
arm  dpdk-tcp         fstack_lat fstack   two
# ergon-io's uring-sqpoll on TCP (transport-aws-smt-off.tsv, transport-aws-smt.tsv):
# its SQPOLL kernel thread on {next_core} (the first CPU of the next isolated
# core) or {loop_sibling} (the loop CPU's SMT sibling: a sets file with smt
# on); no SO_BUSY_POLL (the SQPOLL thread polls the NIC). mio-tcp-smt is
# mio-tcp's row, named for the SMT-on session (its loop's sibling idle).
# UDP has no uring arm: ergon-io's UDP runs on epoll-spin only
arm  eio-tcp-sqpoll-core tcp_lat sockets two --impl ergon --backend uring-sqpoll --sqpoll-cpu {next_core}
arm  eio-tcp-sqpoll-sib  tcp_lat sockets two --impl ergon --backend uring-sqpoll --sqpoll-cpu {loop_sibling}
arm  mio-tcp-smt      tcp_lat    sockets  two  --impl mio
# the socket and Aeron UDP arms again under Onload (transport-aws-onload.tsv)
# (experimental: not viable on ENA, see transport-aws-onload.tsv)
arm  onload-mio-tcp   tcp_lat    onload   two  --impl mio
arm  onload-eio-tcp   tcp_lat    onload   two  --impl ergon
arm  onload-mio-udp   udp_lat    onload   two  --impl mio
arm  onload-eio-udp   udp_lat    onload   two  --impl ergon
arm  onload-aeron-udp aeron_lat  onload   two  --mode udp --reliable false
arm  onload-aeron-rel aeron_lat  onload   two  --mode udp --reliable true
# set   pair par host loads                  streams      netem          arms
set 1    b    p1  a    10000,1000000,5000000  1            -              mpsc,aeron-ipc,aeron-ipc-huge,aa
set 2b   b    p1  b    10000,50000,200000     1            -              aeron-spy,aeron-self,dpdk-aeron-self,aa
set 2a   a    -   ab   10000,50000,200000     1,8,32,128   -              aeron-udp,dpdk-aeron-udp,mio-udp,eio-udp,aa
set fan  a    -   ab   10000,50000,200000     8,32,128     -              mio-tcp,eio-tcp,aa
set 3a   a    -   ab   10000,50000,200000     1            -              aeron-rel,dpdk-aeron-rel,mio-tcp,eio-tcp,aa
set 3b   b    -   ab   10000,50000,200000     1            0.01,0.1,1     aeron-rel,mio-tcp,eio-tcp,aa
set 3c   b    -   ab   10000,50000,200000     1            none,0         aeron-rel,mio-tcp,eio-tcp,aa
